description: (Na)₂LiSmCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiSmCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiSmCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Sm is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form SmCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sm-Cl bond lengths are 2.66 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Sm atom.
